info.title: HoneyForge Backend
info.description: Management API: public name/email/password registration, email login and Bearer JWT. Public registration always grants user role. SMTP supports password reset and one-time email verification. REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION enables a verification gate without changing API shapes. CORS permits only the configured FRONTEND_URL origin. Profiles are shared templates; only administrators modify them. Servers and traps are scoped to the authenticated owner; Viewer is read-only. Registration and desired state do not deploy anything. Port reservations are exclusive per registered server/protocol/port; dispatcher backends use distinct TCP ports. SSH deployment, dispatcher execution and telemetry ingestion are not implemented.
